rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the mint plant, and it can also name the mint flavoring when the food or drink context is clear.

example.english: I like adding a little mint to iced lemon tea.
example.traditional: 我鍾意喺凍檸茶入面加少少薄荷。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 ji3 hai2 dung3 ning2 caa4 jap6 min6 gaa1 siu2 siu2 bok6 ho4

rows.note: Use this for a vast sum of money, rather than for the mint plant or mint products.

example.english: You need to pay a mint to buy this flat.
example.traditional: 要買呢層樓，真係要畀大筆錢。
example.jyutping: jiu3 maai5 ni1 cang4 lau2 zan1 hai6 jiu3 bei2 daai6 bat1 cin2

rows.note: Use this specifically for a mint-flavored candy, especially one eaten to freshen the breath.

example.english: After eating garlic, have a mint before going back to work.
example.traditional: 食完蒜頭，含粒薄荷糖先好返工。
example.jyutping: sik6 jyun4 syun3 tau4 ham4 nap1 bok6 ho4 tong2 sin1 hou2 faan1 gung1
